description: Convert AgentGatewayTester.jsx from mgc-root vertical sections layout to Mock B dark IDE three-column layout.
steps: Read PingOneMcpInspector.js as the reference for Mock B layout structure.

Rewrite AgentGatewayTester.jsx to use the p1mcp-* CSS classes for Mock B three-column layout: (1) Top bar with connection dot (green when gateway is active), title 'Agent Gateway Tester', status showing active gateway name + authorize backend, Refresh/Switch Gateway buttons; (2) Column 1 (tree): list of available MCP tools as tree items (from the tools state, grouped conceptually), with colored dots, active highlight on selected tool, plus a 'Configuration' group showing gateway mode toggles, rate-limit status, and demo preset buttons as actionable tree items; (3) Column 2 (form): selected tool name + description at top, Arguments (JSON) textarea as the parameter field, Execute button + Clear button, plus inline display of gateway/authz state relevant to the call; (4) Column 3 (output): tabbed output with tabs for 'Result', 'Audit Trail', 'Authorize Decision', 'McpAudit (5W1H)' -- each showing the relevant JSON-highlighted section from the response.
Preserve all existing functionality: tool fetching, gateway active state, flag toggling, metadata fetching, rate limiting, burst testing, rule display, and the full audit trail rendering.
Import PingOneMcpInspector.css (already available). Remove or reduce dependency on McpGatewayConfig.css where the p1mcp-* classes cover the same styling.

The demo presets, UC18 rate limiting section, RFC 9728 metadata, and McpAuditFilter description should be accessible from the tree column or as expandable sections within the form/output columns rather than long vertical scroll.

Keep the existing apiClient imports and all API endpoints (/api/mcp-gateway/active, /api/mcp-gateway/test, /api/mcp/inspector/tools, /api/authorize/rules, /api/admin/feature-flags, /api/rfc9728/all, /api/mcp-gateway/rate-limit-status, etc.).
acceptance_criteria: AgentGatewayTester.jsx renders a dark IDE three-column layout with p1mcp-* CSS classes
Column 1 shows tool list as tree items with search/filter capability
Column 2 shows selected tool form with JSON arguments textarea and Execute/Clear buttons
Column 3 shows tabbed output (Result, Audit Trail, Authorize Decision, McpAudit)
Top bar shows connection status, gateway name, and control buttons
All existing API calls and toggle functionality preserved
verification: cd demo_api_ui && HTTPS=false npx vite build
